caption: The drawing depicts a beaded bag with a strap, set against a plain, light-colored background. The bag is rectangular with a slightly tapered bottom, featuring a drawstring closure at the top. The primary color of the bag is a dark gray or black, and it is decorated with a pattern of blue floral and leaf motifs distributed throughout the main body. The top edge of the bag has a decorative, scalloped trim. The strap appears to be made from the same beaded material as the bag, shown laid in gentle curves above the bag. The overall composition centers the bag on the page, with no additional objects or embellishments present in the drawing.
title: Bag
